ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth security proxy and runtime sanitizer specifically designed to intercept and neutralize indirect prompt injections and RAG data poisoning attempts in enterprise LLM deployments.
ideas.title: PromptShield-RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets core challenge domains like RAG Poisoning and Prompt Injection with a robust defense-in-depth architecture similar to successful security entries.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise runtime isolation and permission-bounding layer that prevents Agentic AI privilege escalation by enforcing strict cryptographic constraints on tool-calling and API interactions.
ideas.title: AgentGuard-Privilege
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the cutting-edge topic of Agentic AI Privilege Escalation, which is a major focus area for red-teamers and AI security evaluators at this event.

ideas.pitch: An automated security testing tool and syntax analyzer designed to detect and block NL2SQL Injection vulnerabilities before malicious prompts reach enterprise database execution engines.
ideas.title: SQLSentry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on NL2SQL Injection, an emerging attack vector unique to the AI-powered enterprise ecosystem that judges will be actively testing.

ideas.pitch: An automated scanning framework that maps AI OSINT exposure points and tests enterprise LLM endpoints against advanced multi-turn jailbreaking strategies.
ideas.title: JailBreak-OSINT-Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines AI OSINT and LLM Jailbreaking into a single red-teaming tool, appealing directly to penetration testers and security researchers participating in the challenge.

ideas.pitch: A dependency scanner and integrity verifier for third-party machine learning models and datasets to protect enterprise pipelines against Training Data Poisoning and AI Supply Chain attacks.
ideas.title: SupplyChain-AI-Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fills a critical enterprise security gap by targeting AI Supply Chain Security and Training Data Poisoning, aligning with the event's core security scope.
